name: hgb_round_2
hypothesis: Regularization and tree complexity can stabilize HGB and improve its complementarity with the unchanged CatBoost component of A.
shortlist: Apply the existing development gain/stability gate against the same-feature HGB reference; select by mean Gini, at most one candidate per feature representation, maximum two.
ensemble: Replace only A's HGB component; preserve A's weights. No weight search. Require gain >= ensemble_min_gain against both A and the replacement HGB individual, development stability, and positive paired bootstrap lower bound.
notes: Register before evaluation. Only August-October determine selection. November is not evaluated by this round. No expansion of trials or ensemble weights.
